guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：TLS 憑證自動化
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: TLS certificate automation
guides.concept: 以域名授權、憑證續期與部署一致性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect domain authorization, certificate renewal and deployment consistency through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「ACME 角色」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：客戶端、帳戶與 CA 之间有不同對象責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定域名，只改 challenge 回應是否正確。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「帳戶憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「域名授權」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：挑战驗證控制能力，不是法律所有權證明。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定域名，只改 challenge 回應是否正確。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Challenge 類型」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「名稱覆盖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：憑證的名稱範圍必須與部署服務一致。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較已簽發但未部署與已部署憑證。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「憑證鏈」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Rate limits」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：重试須符合 CA 限制，不能無限密集重複。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定有效期，只改续期服務中斷時長。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「部署原子性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「監測到期」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：到期監測應讀取實際服務的憑證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬雙節點不同鏈版本的轮替。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「事故撤銷」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「TLS 版本核對」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：2026 年 RFC 9846 已取代 8446；實作仍需逐版本核對。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬雙節點不同鏈版本的轮替。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「ACME 角色」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around acme roles, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Clients, accounts and CAs have different object responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix domain and vary challenge response validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat account credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around domain authorization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Challenges validate control, not legal ownership. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix domain and vary challenge response validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat challenge types as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around name coverage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Certificate names must match deployed services. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat certificate chains as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rate limits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retries respect CA limits rather than unlimited repetition. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix validity and vary renewal-service outage duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat atomic deployment as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around expiry monitoring, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Expiry monitoring inspects certificates actually served. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model two nodes rotating inconsistent chain versions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat incident revocation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around tls-version checks, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RFC 9846 supersedes 8446 in 2026; implementations need version-specific checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model two nodes rotating inconsistent chain versions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat acme roles as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「回滚邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rollback boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 取得憑證等於取得網站全部業務授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Obtaining a certificate grants all website business permissions. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由域名授權、憑證續期與部署一致性連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect domain authorization, certificate renewal and deployment consistency to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 公鑰基礎建設
related.why: 可移植「ACME 角色」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from acme roles; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「ACME 角色」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from acme roles; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理域名授權、憑證續期與部署一致性；「公鑰基礎建設」主要處理信任錨、憑證路徑與撤銷，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes domain authorization, certificate renewal and deployment consistency; Public-key infrastructure emphasizes trust anchors, certificate paths and revocation. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「TLS 憑證自動化」與「公鑰基礎建設」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「Challenge 類型」的對照方法至「簽章驗證」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw TLS certificate automation and Public-key infrastructure flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from challenge types to signature validation, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
